scope: Backend CPU is exact cgroup accounting including exited children. RSS is sampled aggregate process RSS, shared pages counted per process. Stack adds existing ML/PostgreSQL/Redis descendants. Ancillary CPU is a sampled lower bound; short-lived DB children may be missed. Includes untimed fixture uploads, warmup and queue drain, excludes source/fixture generation and service startup. Cgroup memory.peak includes startup and file cache. Unattributed CPU includes sampling gaps; reject runs above max(5 CPU seconds, 5% of host busy CPU).
